verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developer.vanta.com describing the APIs and MCP server. Doc pages are served as .md files that point agents to the llms.txt index. Vanta also publishes agentskills.io-spec skill files and a developer-docs MCP server that offers doc search and serves every page as a skill.md resource. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs well, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
